reference.settle: Six identical projections separated by three requestAnimationFrame callbacks; no synthetic align or resize events
reference.source: Unmodified official UMD; actual responsive TreeSelect Overflow geometry, scoped physical hit probes and popup anchors; no Native implementation or layout predictions
reference.geometry: Rectangles relative to content; popup relative to root with block gap and logical anchor. Rect coordinates round to 0.001 CSS px; actual offset/client/scroll dimensions remain integers.
